issue.title: xprompt LSP re-offers already-bound keyword arguments: CompletionContext has no used_arg_names, so the server passes an empty set
issue.description: The xprompt LSP's keyword-argument completion never filters out keywords the document already binds, because the shared completion context does not carry them. Found while designing selectable xprompt keyword-argument completion for the ACE prompt input widget.

task_type_fields.impact:
**Impact:** every external editor using the xprompt LSP re-offers keyword arguments the
document has already bound, on every xprompt call with more than one keyword argument.
Accepting one of those rows produces a duplicate keyword, which
`argument_diagnostics` then flags as `duplicate_xprompt_arg` — the completion menu leads
the user straight into a diagnostic the same server publishes. ACE is unaffected.

**Adjacent parity gap, same call site:** ACE does not consume
`build_xprompt_arg_name_candidates` at all; it reimplements it in Python. Fixing the
`used_arg_names` defect is a good moment to expose the Rust context/candidate pair through
`sase_core_rs` and retire the Python duplicate, per
`sase/memory/rust_core_backend_boundary.md`. That half needs a published `sase-core-rs`
floor, so it can be sequenced after the LSP fix rather than blocking it.
task_type_fields.location: crates/sase_xprompt_lsp/src/server.rs (CompletionContextKind::XpromptArgumentName arm) and CompletionContext in crates/sase_core/src/editor/completion.rs, both in the sase-core repo
task_type_fields.repro:
**Reproduce (sase-core master, `crates/sase_xprompt_lsp/src/server.rs` around line 1521):**
the `CompletionContextKind::XpromptArgumentName` arm calls
`editor_build_xprompt_arg_name_candidates(entry, &Default::default(), token, ...)`.
The second parameter is `used_arg_names: &BTreeSet<String>`; passing `Default::default()`
hands the builder an always-empty set, so its
`if used_arg_names.contains(&input.name) { continue; }` filter never fires.

Open a document containing `#review(count=1, ` in an LSP client and request completion:
the server offers `count=` again alongside the unused keywords. ACE, which filters on
`ctx.used_arg_names` in `_build_named_arg_completion_candidates`
(`src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_file_completion_xprompt_args.py`), correctly omits it, so the
two surfaces disagree on the same text.

The root cause is one level deeper: `CompletionContext` in
`crates/sase_core/src/editor/completion.rs` carries `selected_values` but has no
`used_arg_names` field, so `detect_xprompt_arg_completion_at_position` never surfaces the
already-bound keyword names it walks past. The LSP has nothing correct to pass. The fix is
to add the field to the context (and its wire type), populate it in that detector the way
the Python `_used_named_arg_names` helper does, and pass it through in the LSP arm.

Introduced by `0d1637b` ("feat: add xprompt LSP server skeleton", 2026-05-07); it is not
a regression from epic `sase-rj`, whose four phases were `%directive`-scoped.
